AND (API_NO != #{apiNo})

AND (API_SPC_NO != #{apiSpcNo})

/* apiReg.selImportApiList */
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY A.AMD_DT DESC) rownum , A.API_SPC_NO , A.API_SPC_ID , A.SYS_ID , COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS SYS_ID_NM , A.AMDR , COALESCE(M.MBR_NM,'') AS AMDR_NM , A.VER , A.API_NM , A.RFRN_TMPLT_NO , A.API_DESC FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_MBR M ON (A.AMDR = M.MBR_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.SYS_ID) WHERE (A.DEL_YN = 'N') AND (A.SHOW_YN = 'Y')
AND (A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030') AND ((A.TMPLT_YN != 'Y') OR (A.TMPLT_YN IS NULL))
AND (A.TMPLT_YN = 'Y')
AND ( (A.API_DESC LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schText}, '%')) OR ( A.SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SYS_ID FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM B WHERE (B.SYS_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schText}, '%')) ) ) OR (A.AMDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schText}, '%')) OR (A.API_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schText}, '%')) )

mapper.select: /* apiReg.selApiInfo */ SELECT A.API_SPC_NO , API_SPC_ID , VER , API_NM , API_DESC , AUT_ID , A.SYS_ID , COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS SYS_ID_NM , S.MIN_ID , S.MAX_ID , COALESCE(A.VER_DESC,'') AS VER_DESC , RFRN_WSDL_URL , RFRN_TMPLT_NO , RFRN_API_SPC_NO , HOST , BAS_PATH , YAML_FILE_PATH , YAML_FILE_NM , REG_STTUS_CD , COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS REG_STTUS_CD_NM , TMPLT_YN , A.REGR , A.AMD_DT , A.AMDR , A.DEL_YN , YAML_SBST , API_CLASS , BSTGW_YN , API_VERI_BASEURL , COALESCE(A.PROJECT_NS,'') AS PROJECT_NAMESPACE , A.API_NM AS PROJECT_NAME FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (A.REG_STTUS_CD = D.COMN_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'APIREG1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.SYS_ID) WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo})
/* apiReg.selCateInfo */ SELECT * FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY WHERE (API_CTGRY_NO = #{apiCtgryNo}) AND (API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (DEL_YN = 'N') ORDER BY SORT_ODRG ASC
/* apiReg.selCateList */ SELECT * FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY WHERE (API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (DEL_YN = 'N') ORDER BY SORT_ODRG ASC

/* apiReg.selPathList */ SELECT * FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE (API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND ( API_CTGRY_NO NOT IN ( SELECT API_CTGRY_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY B WHERE (B.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (DEL_YN = 'N') ) ) ORDER BY SORT_ODRG ASC

/* apiReg.selCatePathList */ SELECT A.* FROM ( ( SELECT A.API_CTGRY_NO, '' AS CTGRY_NM, A.API_NO, A.API_NM, A.API_PATH, A.METHOD_CD, COALESCE(B.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD_NM, 3 AS SORT_ORDER, 0 AS PATH_CNT, ( CASE WHEN A.USE_YN IS NULL OR A.USE_YN ='' THEN 'N' ELSE A.USE_YN END ) AS USE_YN, A.API_GUBUN FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD B ON (A.METHOD_CD = B.COMN_CD AND B.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) ) UNION ALL ( SELECT A.API_CTGRY_NO, '' AS CTGRY_NM, '' AS API_NO, '' AS API_NM, A.API_PATH, '' AS METHOD_CD, '' AS METHOD_NM, 2 AS SORT_ORDER, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF B WHERE (B.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (B.API_CTGRY_NO = B.API_CTGRY_NO) AND (B.API_PATH = A.API_PATH) ) AS PATH_CNT, A.USE_YN, A.API_GUBUN FROM ( SELECT A.API_CTGRY_NO, A.API_PATH, A.USE_YN, A.API_GUBUN FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) GROUP BY A.API_CTGRY_NO, A.API_PATH, A.API_GUBUN, A.USE_YN ) A ) UNION ALL ( SELECT A.API_CTGRY_NO, A.CTGRY_NM, 0 AS API_NO, '' AS API_NM, '' AS API_PATH, '' AS METHOD_CD, '' AS METHOD_NM, 1 AS SORT_ORDER, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT A.API_CTGRY_NO, A.API_PATH FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) GROUP BY A.API_CTGRY_NO, A.API_PATH ) B WHERE (B.API_CTGRY_NO = A.API_CTGRY_NO) ) AS PATH_CNT, '' AS USE_YN, '' AS API_GUBUN FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (A.DEL_YN = 'N') ) ) A ORDER BY A.API_CTGRY_NO ASC, A.SORT_ORDER ASC, A.API_NO

/* apiReg.selMethodDupList */ SELECT A.* FROM KOA_TB_COMN_CD A WHERE (A.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') AND ( A.COMN_CD NOT IN ( SELECT METHOD_CD FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (A.API_CTGRY_NO = #{apiCtgryNo}) GROUP BY API_PATH, METHOD_CD ) ) ORDER BY A.SORT_ODRG ASC

/* apiReg.salApijDupPathCheck */ SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS COUNT FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (A.API_PATH = #{apiPath}) AND (A.METHOD_CD = #{methodCd}) AND (A.API_NO != #{apiNo})

mapper.select: /* apiReg.selApiDef */ SELECT A.API_NO , A.API_SPC_NO , A.API_NM , A.API_CTGRY_NO , A.API_PATH , A.METHOD_CD , A.API_ID , A.API_DESC , A.REG_DT , A.REGR , A.AMD_DT , A.AMDR , A.SORT_ODRG , A.SHOW_STATUS_CD , A.USE_YN , A.API_GUBUN , A.API_HANDLER_CD , A.ENDPNT_METHOD_CD , A.ENDPNT_TB_URL , A.ENDPNT_PRD_URL , A.ENDPNT_TIMEOUT , A.ENDPNT_CLIENT_IP , A.RESMAP_RES_CD_FIELD , A.RESMAP_SUCC_VAL , A.RESMAP_ERR_CD_FIELD , A.RESMAP_ERR_MSG_FIELD , A.HDP_API_OUT_FORMAT , A.HDP_API_OUT_COMMON_PARAM , A.HDP_API_ENDPOINT_ID , A.HDP_REQ_API_NAME , A.HDP_REQ_CONFIG_TO_BODY , A.HDP_REQ_HEADER_TO_BODY , A.HDP_REQ_MAPPING_TO_BODY , A.HDP_REQ_URL_DECODE , A.HDP_REQ_URL_ENCODE , A.HDP_RES_MAPPING_TO_BODY , A.HDP_RES_PROVIDE_PARAM , A.HDP_RES_URL_ENCODE , A.HDP_EXT_PROP , A.HDP_HNDLROPTN_CONFIG , A.API_VER , A.API_VER_NO , A.SANDBOX_YN , A.GUIDE_GUBUN , A.API_CONN_GUBUN , A.GUIDE_TWO_GROUP , A.EDIT_FLAG , A.DEPLOY_FLAG , A.PROVIDER_SEQ , A.BSTGW_TB_SYS_ID , COALESCE((SELECT sub.SYS_NM FROM BST_SYNC_TB_ADM_SYS_DPLY sub WHERE (sub.SYS_ID = A.BSTGW_TB_SYS_ID)), '') AS BSTGW_TB_SYS_NM , A.BSTGW_PRD_SYS_ID , COALESCE((SELECT sub.SYS_NM FROM BST_SYNC_ADM_SYS_DPLY sub WHERE (sub.SYS_ID = A.BSTGW_PRD_SYS_ID)), '') AS BSTGW_PRD_SYS_NM , A.DPLY_REQ_FLAG , TO_CHAR(A.DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE , A.TB_DPLY_STATUS , TO_CHAR(A.TB_DPLY_STATUS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TB_DPLY_STATUS_DATE , A.DPLY_VERI_STATUS , TO_CHAR(A.DPLY_VERI_STATUS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DPLY_VERI_STATUS_DATE , A.PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG , TO_CHAR(A.PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG , A.PRD_DPLY_STATUS , TO_CHAR(A.PRD_DPLY_STATUS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PRD_DPLY_STATUS_DATE , KTAI.IMPACT , KTAI.API_USER , KTAI.REPROCESSABLE_YN , KTAI.INTEGRATION_TYPE , KTAI.API_METHOD , KTAI.ENABLER_INFO , KTAI.COMMENTS FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_IMPACT AS KTAI ON A.API_NO = KTAI.API_NO WHERE (A.API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* apiReg.selApiDefList */ SELECT A.API_NO , A.API_SPC_NO , A.API_NM , A.API_CTGRY_NO , A.API_PATH , A.METHOD_CD , A.API_ID , A.API_DESC , A.REG_DT , A.REGR , A.AMD_DT , A.AMDR , A.SORT_ODRG , A.SHOW_STATUS_CD , A.USE_YN , A.API_GUBUN , A.API_HANDLER_CD , A.API_VER , A.API_VER_NO , A.API_CONN_GUBUN , A.GUIDE_TWO_GROUP , A.EDIT_FLAG , A.DEPLOY_FLAG FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo})

/* apiReg.selApiDataTypeUseList */ SELECT * FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE (DATA_TYPE_CD = 'DATTYP1090') AND (API_NO IN (SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE (API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo})))
mapper.update: /* apiReg.updApiDefEditFlag */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET AMD_DT = NOW() , EDIT_FLAG = (CASE WHEN (UPPER(#{editFlag}) IN ('Y', 'N')) THEN UPPER(#{editFlag}) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* apiReg.updApiDefDplyReqFlag */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE = NOW() , DPLY_REQ_FLAG = (CASE WHEN (UPPER(#{dplyReqFlag}) IN ('', 'REQ', 'NK', 'OK')) THEN UPPER(#{dplyReqFlag}) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* apiReg.updApiDefTbDplyStatus */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET TB_DPLY_STATUS_DATE = NOW() , TB_DPLY_STATUS = (CASE WHEN (UPPER(#{tbDplyStatus}) IN ('', 'NK', 'OK')) THEN UPPER(#{tbDplyStatus}) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* apiReg.updApiDefDplyVeriStatus */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET DPLY_VERI_STATUS_DATE = NOW() , DPLY_VERI_STATUS = (CASE WHEN (UPPER(#{dplyVeriStatus}) IN ('', 'NK', 'OK')) THEN UPPER(#{dplyVeriStatus}) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* apiReg.updApiDefPrdDplyReqFlag */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG_DATE = NOW() , PRD_DPLY_REQ_FLAG = (CASE WHEN (UPPER(#{prdDplyReqFlag}) IN ('', 'REQ', 'NK', 'OK')) THEN UPPER(#{prdDplyReqFlag}) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo})

/* apiReg.updApiDefPrdDplyStatus */ UPDATE KOA_TB_API_DEF SET PRD_DPLY_STATUS_DATE = NOW() , PRD_DPLY_STATUS = (CASE WHEN (UPPER(#{prdDplyStatus}) IN ('', 'NK', 'OK')) THEN UPPER(#{prdDplyStatus}) ELSE NULL END) WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo})
mapper.select: /* apiReg.selApiCountAndInfoByProjectNs */ SELECT A.NAMESPACE , A.API_COUNT , A.UPDATE_TIME FROM ( SELECT B.PROJECT_NS AS NAMESPACE , COUNT(A.API_SPC_NO) OVER(PARTITION BY B.PROJECT_NS) AS API_COUNT , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(B.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),TO_CHAR(B.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS UPDATE_TIME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.PROJECT_NS ORDER BY COALESCE(TO_CHAR(B.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),TO_CHAR(B.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) DESC) AS RANK FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A RIGHT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC B ON (A.API_SPC_NO=B.API_SPC_NO AND B.DEL_YN = 'N') WHERE B.PROJECT_NS IS NOT NULL ) A WHERE A.RANK = 1

/* apiReg.select_APINO_CHECK */ SELECT COALESCE((SELECT A.API_PATH FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (A.API_NO = #{apiNo}) ), '') AS path , COALESCE((SELECT LOWER(sub.CD_NM) FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD sub ON (sub.COMN_CD = A.METHOD_CD AND sub.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (A.API_NO = #{apiNo}) ), '') AS method , COALESCE((SELECT MAX(A.API_NO) FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD sub ON (sub.COMN_CD = A.METHOD_CD AND sub.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}) AND (A.API_PATH = #{path}) AND (UPPER(sub.CD_NM) = UPPER(#{method})) ), 0) AS max_apino

/* apiReg.selApiProviderList */ SELECT pvd.SEQ AS seq , pvd.PROVIDER_NM AS providerNm , pvd.eStdSvcCode AS eStdSvcCode , pvd.BIGO AS bigo , TO_CHAR(pvd.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS amdDt , pvd.AMDR AS amdr FROM KOA_TB_API_PROVIDER pvd WHERE (pvd.USE_YN = 'Y') ORDER BY COALESCE(pvd.SORT_ODRG, 999), pvd.PROVIDER_NM, pvd.SEQ
SELECT API_NM, API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_NM = #{apiNm} AND API_ID = #{apiId}
SELECT COUNT(API_NO) FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}
SELECT COUNT(API_ID) FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_ID = replace(#{apiId},' ','')

/* adpt.selNextApiId */ SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT (SUBSTRING(MAX(API_ID), 1, 5) || RIGHT('0000' || CAST((CAST(SUBSTRING(MAX(API_ID), 6, 4) AS INTEGER) + 1) AS VARCHAR), 4)) FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE (API_ID LIKE (#{prefix} + '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'))) , (#{prefix} + '0001')) AS NEXT_API_ID

/* adpt.selNextApiIdInfo */ SELECT PREFIX_API_ID AS prefix , MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen}) AS INTEGER)) AS curMinId , MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen}) AS INTEGER)) AS curMaxId
, COALESCE((SELECT MIN_ID::INTEGER FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM WHERE (SYS_ID = #{sysId}) AND (MIN_ID ~ '^\d+$') AND (MAX_ID ~ '^\d+$')), -999) AS sysMinId , COALESCE((SELECT MAX_ID::INTEGER FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM WHERE (SYS_ID = #{sysId}) AND (MIN_ID ~ '^\d+$') AND (MAX_ID ~ '^\d+$')), -999) AS sysMaxId
FROM ( SELECT sub.API_ID , LEFT(sub.API_ID, LENGTH('' + #{prefix})) AS PREFIX_API_ID FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF sub ) tab WHERE (PREFIX_API_ID = #{prefix}) AND (SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen}) ~ '^\d+$')
AND (SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen})::INTEGER >= #{minId})
AND (SUBSTRING(API_ID, (LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1), #{rangeLen})::INTEGER <= #{maxId})
GROUP BY PREFIX_API_ID

/* adpt.selDeployProc */ SELECT D.API_NO ,D.DEPLOY_CD ,D.VERIFI_CD ,TO_CHAR(D.DEPLOY_ST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DEPLOY_ST_DT FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC D WHERE (D.API_NO = #{apiNo}) ORDER BY D.DEPLOY_ST_DT DESC, SEQ DESC
LIMIT #{top}
